intellect.extreme_high: You think three moves ahead while everyone else argues the first.
intellect.extreme_low: Ideas feel like noise; you trust what’s proven instead.
intellect.high_domain_low_facet: You crave variety but your mind sticks to one reliable path.
intellect.low_domain_high_facet: Usually steady, but when a concept grabs you you obsess.
intellect.contrast: You explore broadly, yet this idea keeps pulling you inward.
intellect.neutral: You notice patterns others miss and quietly test them.

adventurousness.extreme_high: You chase the unknown the way others collect routines.
adventurousness.extreme_low: Risk makes your gut cold; predictability is your refuge.
adventurousness.high_domain_low_facet: You love novelty in theory but freeze at the first leap.
adventurousness.low_domain_high_facet: Mostly cautious, but once you jump you don’t look back.
adventurousness.contrast: You flirt with adventure then return to the safe shore.
adventurousness.neutral: You pick novel paths when the payoff is obvious.

artistic.extreme_high: You turn small moments into scenes other people remember.
artistic.extreme_low: Beauty rarely moves you; function comes first.
artistic.high_domain_low_facet: Curious and open, yet you hold back from showing your taste.
artistic.low_domain_high_facet: Not the loud type, but your aesthetic calls attention anyway.
artistic.contrast: You feel creative sparks that you rarely let finish.
artistic.neutral: You have a subtle aesthetic that shows up at the right time.

openness.extreme_high: New frameworks excite you; sticking with the old feels like imprisonment.
openness.extreme_low: You prefer rules that work over ideas that might.
openness.high_domain_low_facet: You say you want change but keep choosing the familiar.
openness.low_domain_high_facet: You appear conventional, yet your tastes betray a rebel.
openness.contrast: You balance curiosity with a quiet need for structure.
openness.neutral: You sample new ideas selectively, not indiscriminately.

emotionality.extreme_high: You feel undercurrents others call ‘mood’ and react before they do.
emotionality.extreme_low: Emotions are background for you, not the director.
emotionality.high_domain_low_facet: Open-minded but emotionally reserved; you watch more than you say.
emotionality.low_domain_high_facet: You seem unflappable until an old hurt surfaces suddenly.
emotionality.contrast: You’re intellectually curious but keep your heart carefully shielded.
emotionality.neutral: You sense emotional layers and file them away for later.

liberalism.extreme_high: You reject the obvious labels and rewrite the rulebook quietly.
liberalism.extreme_low: Tradition anchors you; change needs a strong reason.
liberalism.high_domain_low_facet: You like new ideas yet hesitate to break shared norms.
liberalism.low_domain_high_facet: Conservative outwardly, but you back unexpected causes fiercely.
liberalism.contrast: You want progress but only on your terms.
liberalism.neutral: You test new beliefs against practical outcomes before adopting them.

orderliness.extreme_high: Your space and schedule are precise because your mind needs edges.
orderliness.extreme_low: Chaos accumulates until urgency forces cleanup.
orderliness.high_domain_low_facet: Disciplined in goals, messy in the small stuff that actually slows you down.
orderliness.low_domain_high_facet: Mostly loose, but when order matters you become surgical.
orderliness.contrast: You plan big moves but leave little details to chance.
orderliness.neutral: You keep things just tidy enough to get things done.

self-discipline.extreme_high: You follow through where most people stall.
self-discipline.extreme_low: Good intentions pile up into undone to-dos.
self-discipline.high_domain_low_facet: You want control but your habits betray you at the finish line.
self-discipline.low_domain_high_facet: Usually lax, yet when you lock in you deliver beyond expectation.
self-discipline.contrast: You set standards but sometimes fail to enforce them on yourself.
self-discipline.neutral: You hit targets when they matter and skim when they don’t.

achievement.extreme_high: Mediocre trophies make you anxious; you aim for undeniable wins.
achievement.extreme_low: Status doesn’t move you; competence quietly does.
achievement.high_domain_low_facet: You value competence but avoid chasing accolades that feel hollow.
achievement.low_domain_high_facet: Not competitive by default, yet you excel when a goal catches you.
achievement.contrast: You balance ambition with a low-key tolerance for failure.
achievement.neutral: You work toward meaningful goals, not just appearances.

self-efficacy.extreme_high: You assume you can fix it and usually do.
self-efficacy.extreme_low: You doubt your tools even when they are in your hands.
self-efficacy.high_domain_low_facet: Responsible and dependable, but you sometimes question your own impact.
self-efficacy.low_domain_high_facet: Quiet about capability, then you quietly solve what others called impossible.
self-efficacy.contrast: You plan like a boss but second-guess the execution.
self-efficacy.neutral: You learn fast and trust the process once you see results.

cautiousness.extreme_high: You map threats before anyone else notices them.
cautiousness.extreme_low: You jump first and fix problems later.
cautiousness.high_domain_low_facet: You prefer structure yet take surprising gambles when pressed.
cautiousness.low_domain_high_facet: Generally bold, but you pause sharply at real risk.
cautiousness.contrast: You hedge in places others act reckless and act bravely where others hedge.
cautiousness.neutral: You measure danger and act when the expected value is clear.

dutifulness.extreme_high: You keep promises the rest of the world forgets.
dutifulness.extreme_low: Commitments fade unless they serve you explicitly.
dutifulness.high_domain_low_facet: You value standards but sometimes skip the small loyal acts.
dutifulness.low_domain_high_facet: Not visibly loyal, yet you show up when it truly counts.
dutifulness.contrast: You honor principles selectively, where they matter most to you.
dutifulness.neutral: You’re dependable in contexts you choose to invest in.

assertiveness.extreme_high: You don’t wait for permission; you move people.
assertiveness.extreme_low: You let others steer and then wonder why direction lacked.
assertiveness.high_domain_low_facet: Social and lively, yet you back down at the decisive moment.
assertiveness.low_domain_high_facet: Quiet by default, but when you speak everyone listens.
assertiveness.contrast: You project energy but hold back where the stakes feel personal.
assertiveness.neutral: You lead quietly and loudly depending on what the room needs.

activity level.extreme_high: Your days are dense; you treat time like a resource to harvest.
activity level.extreme_low: You prefer slow rhythms and deep focus over constant motion.
activity level.high_domain_low_facet: Energetic overall, but you reserve bursts for the things that matter.
activity level.low_domain_high_facet: Mostly calm, but when momentum hits you become unstoppable.
activity level.contrast: You move fast in some lanes and slow in others by design.
activity level.neutral: You manage your energy and pick your sprints.

gregariousness.extreme_high: People find you magnetizing without knowing why.
gregariousness.extreme_low: Crowds drain you and you protect your quiet fiercely.
gregariousness.high_domain_low_facet: Outgoing but selective; vast networks are not your thing.
gregariousness.low_domain_high_facet: Not the social center, yet you make strong connections quickly.
gregariousness.contrast: You love people on your terms and avoid the small talk.
gregariousness.neutral: You enjoy company that adds value and avoid filler.

excitement-seeking.extreme_high: Boredom is your enemy; you design scenarios that wake you up.
excitement-seeking.extreme_low: You prefer steady pleasures over risky thrills.
excitement-seeking.high_domain_low_facet: Social and lively, but you avoid reckless novelty.
excitement-seeking.low_domain_high_facet: Mostly steady, but you seek a jolt when routine suffocates you.
excitement-seeking.contrast: You crave meaningful novelty rather than random adrenaline.
excitement-seeking.neutral: You take risks when curiosity outweighs cost.

cheerfulness.extreme_high: You smile first and people match your tempo.
cheerfulness.extreme_low: Joy is rare and often private for you.
cheerfulness.high_domain_low_facet: Energetic outwardly but you keep your worries private.
cheerfulness.low_domain_high_facet: Not loud, yet your presence lifts people unexpectedly.
cheerfulness.contrast: You can lighten a room while holding your own serious strains.
cheerfulness.neutral: You bring warmth when it’s needed and focus when it’s not.

friendliness.extreme_high: You trust quickly and people reciprocate naturally.
friendliness.extreme_low: You’re cautious with warmth until trust is earned.
friendliness.high_domain_low_facet: Social overall, but you guard some relationships tightly.
friendliness.low_domain_high_facet: Not openly social, yet you form fast, deep bonds.
friendliness.contrast: You give warmth selectively and it lands precisely where you want it to.
friendliness.neutral: You’re approachable to those who matter to you.

altruism.extreme_high: You give before being asked and feel it’s the least you can do.
altruism.extreme_low: You expect reciprocity and you’re careful with favors.
altruism.high_domain_low_facet: Kind by default but you ration deep sacrifice for real causes.
altruism.low_domain_high_facet: Practical outwardly, yet you unexpectedly help when it counts.
altruism.contrast: You balance self-interest with genuine care in strategic places.
altruism.neutral: You help where your help makes a measurable difference.

trust.extreme_high: You assume goodwill and others rarely disappoint you.
trust.extreme_low: You read motives before you hand over confidence.
trust.high_domain_low_facet: Warm and cooperative, but you remain skeptical of strangers.
trust.low_domain_high_facet: Guarded by default, yet you grant trust to the few you choose.
trust.contrast: You believe in people but verify before you commit deeply.
trust.neutral: You calibrate trust to track record, not charm.

cooperation.extreme_high: You default to 'how can I help' and teams run better because of you.
cooperation.extreme_low: You prefer clear lanes and private ownership over group fuzziness.
cooperation.high_domain_low_facet: Friendly but selective about teamwork; you pick your collaborations.
cooperation.low_domain_high_facet: Not outwardly team-first, yet you become the backbone when needed.
cooperation.contrast: You cooperate when alignment is clear and withdraw when it isn’t.
cooperation.neutral: You collaborate when the outcome is worth the coordination.

morality.extreme_high: Your inner code runs strict; compromises bother you.
morality.extreme_low: You negotiate ethics against outcomes and move on.
morality.high_domain_low_facet: Compassionate overall, yet you bend rules when practical needs demand it.
morality.low_domain_high_facet: Not overtly principled, yet you hold nonnegotiables fiercely.
morality.contrast: You balance moral clarity with pragmatic exceptions.
morality.neutral: You act by a personal standard that feels inevitable to you.

modesty.extreme_high: You deflect praise until the work proves undeniable.
modesty.extreme_low: You claim credit quickly and unapologetically.
modesty.high_domain_low_facet: Generous and humble, but you step into the spotlight when it matters.
modesty.low_domain_high_facet: Not outwardly modest, yet you prefer quiet recognition.
modesty.contrast: You oscillate between deflection and earned visibility.
modesty.neutral: You let results speak and accept credit when it serves the mission.

sympathy.extreme_high: You feel other people’s pain in real time and act on it.
sympathy.extreme_low: You keep distance; empathy is a tool, not a burden.
sympathy.high_domain_low_facet: Warm and fair, but you protect your emotional bandwidth.
sympathy.low_domain_high_facet: Appears detached, yet you respond sharply when a real need appears.
sympathy.contrast: You match empathy to capacity so you can keep giving long term.
sympathy.neutral: You care in ways that are sustainable and useful.

anxiety.extreme_high: You foresee problems others miss and prepare for them obsessively.
anxiety.extreme_low: Worry rarely slows you; you act before fear arrives.
anxiety.high_domain_low_facet: Sensitive and aware, but you hide the worry under competence.
anxiety.low_domain_high_facet: Usually steady, yet certain triggers make you spiral unexpectedly.
anxiety.contrast: You plan for threats while the room stays calm.
anxiety.neutral: You stay vigilant and use it as a signal, not a jail.

depression.extreme_high: Quiet heaviness sits under your days and people rarely see it.
depression.extreme_low: You shrug off low moods and keep moving.
depression.high_domain_low_facet: Emotionally reactive yet you mask the low days from most people.
depression.low_domain_high_facet: Generally resilient, but you can drop deeply and silently.
depression.contrast: You carry seriousness where others expect lightness.
depression.neutral: You have low days and you know how to make them shorter.

self-consciousness.extreme_high: You run rehearsals in your head long after the conversation ends.
self-consciousness.extreme_low: You move without self-edit and rarely look back.
self-consciousness.high_domain_low_facet: Sensitive to judgment inside, but you present a calm exterior.
self-consciousness.low_domain_high_facet: Not outwardly anxious, yet certain scenes replay in your mind.
self-consciousness.contrast: You present confidently while your inner critic takes notes.
self-consciousness.neutral: You notice how you land and adjust quietly.

vulnerability.extreme_high: You feel exposure like physical pain and protect your soft spots fiercely.
vulnerability.extreme_low: You tolerate exposure with a practical shrug.
vulnerability.high_domain_low_facet: Emotionally reactive but you share only with a strict inner circle.
vulnerability.low_domain_high_facet: Mostly guarded, yet you reveal unexpectedly to the right person.
vulnerability.contrast: You expect risk but only accept it on your terms.
vulnerability.neutral: You open selectively and keep your core safe.

anger.extreme_high: Small slights register as big infractions and you act on them.
anger.extreme_low: You swallow frustrations and move on deliberately.
anger.high_domain_low_facet: Emotionally intense but you rarely let anger become your story.
anger.low_domain_high_facet: Calm most of the time, but when provoked you are unmistakable.
anger.contrast: You simmer quietly until a single line is crossed.
anger.neutral: You express frustration clearly when necessary and then let it go.

immoderation.extreme_high: When you lose control you go all the way; restraint is not your fallback.
immoderation.extreme_low: You ration pleasures intentionally and rarely binge.
immoderation.high_domain_low_facet: Prone to worry, yet you keep impulses contained most of the time.
immoderation.low_domain_high_facet: Generally steady, but occasional excesses catch even you by surprise.
immoderation.contrast: You oscillate between strict self-control and rare abandon.
immoderation.neutral: You indulge with awareness and accept the consequences.
